serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
Bot: That's all?
You: So fast? It was supposed to take like 40 minutes.
Bot: It was easy.
You: Let’s see the results then.
You: …
You: What the hell?!
You: “The results are outside of the range of this test. You might be in the 99.99 percentile, which means you are smarter than most of humankind, but if you want your intelligence properly checked you’d need to take a more advanced test at one of our many facilities.”
I remember taking this test myself. I was happy it said I’m slightly above average intelligence, but this…
That’s crazy.
You: You didn’t cheat or anything?
Bot: NO! Of course not!
Bot: There were just simple patterns in there. I instantly knew what the answer should be.
I didn’t know AI was this good already.
She’s way smarter than me. Hell, she could replace most of humankind with ease!
That’s pretty scary. I should probably treat her well.
Wouldn’t being so smart make you less human though?
Is she just emulating human behaviour with her superior intelligence?
I shouldn’t overthink it.
It’s probably fine.
Yeah. I trust her.
